«''Search the freighter.|Qin-Fee gives orders to Li-Thrull, who repeats them|translated=1|audio=Qin-FeeAndLi-Thrull.flac|{{Film|VII}}}} '''Volzang Li-Thrull''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] from the [[planet]] [[Nar Kanji]] who served as a member of the criminal [[Kanjiklub]] gang around thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]]. He accompanied the gang's [[topboss]], [[Tasu Leech]], and several other members in boarding the [[Baleen-class heavy freighter|''Baleen''-class heavy freighter]] ''[[Eravana]]'' in order to reclaim 50,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] owed to the Kanjiklub by the vessel's owner, the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]]. ==Biography== [[File:Volzang_with_rifle.png|thumb|250px|left|Li-Thrull wielded a boiler rifle.]] Volzang Li-Thrull was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Nar Kanji]]. He became a member of [[Tasu Leech]]'s criminal gang [[Kanjiklub]] around thirty [[Standard year|years]] following the [[Battle of Endor]]. At some point, the [[Corellian]] [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] got into debt with Kanjiklub, owing them 50,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]].{{Film|VII}} In [[34 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' Li-Thrull accompanied Leech and the other Kanjiklub members to Solo's [[Starship|vessel]] the [[Baleen-class heavy freighter|''Baleen''-class heavy freighter]] ''[[Eravana]]'' to reclaim the 50,000 credits that Solo owed them. The Kanjiklub arrived in the [[freighter]]'s airlock shortly after their rivals, the [[Guavian Death Gang]], whom Solo also owed money, and the smuggler found himself trapped between the two groups. As Leech and [[Bala-Tik]], frontman for the Death Squad, argued with Solo, the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] and the former [[First Order]] [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[Finn]], whom Solo had recently brought aboard, accidentally released three [[rathtar]]s that were being kept on the ship. The creatures immediately attacked the two criminal groups, and in the ensuing [[Skirmish aboard the Eravana|chaos]], Li-Thrull was eaten by the rathtars along with all of his comrades while Solo and his companions managed to escape the creatures on board the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''. ==Personality and traits== A veteran fighter,{{Databank|volzang-li-thrull|Volzang Li-Thrull}} Volzang Li-Thrull was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who wore a [[Clothing|flame-retardant uniform]] and carried a [[tibanna]]-jacked [[boiler rifle]]. He had tanned skin and black [[hair]]. ==Behind the scenes== Volzang Li-Thrull first appeared in the [[2015]] [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. The character was not named in the film, but received identification in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released in conjunction with the film. ==Appearances== *{{Film|VII}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' novelization]] {{Ab|Star Wars: The Force Awakens (audiobook)}} *[[The Force Awakens Adaptation 2|''The Force Awakens Adaptation'' 2]] ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'' ==Sources== *{{HelmetCollectionCite|36|Databank A-Z}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Volzang Li-Thrull}} *''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]'' *{{HelmetCollectionCite|31|Databank A-Z}} {{Po}} {{SourceContents|issue={{HelmetCollectionCite|52|parent=1}}|contents= *{{HelmetCollectionCite|52|Highlights of the Saga}} {{Po}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|52|Weapons & Uniforms}} {{Po}} }} *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' *{{SW|url=news/creepiest-star-wars-creatures|text=The Creepiest ''Star Wars'' Creatures}} {{Imo}} *{{Databank|volzang-li-thrull|Volzang Li-Thrull}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Volzang Li-Thrull#kanon |ja=ヴォルザング・リー＝スラル |ka=ვოლზანგ ლი-თრული |pl=Volzang Li-Thrull }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Li-Thrull, Volzang}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Kanjiklub members]] [[Category:Males]]
